alt: A row of daily temperatures with a row of waits beneath it, next to a stack of day numbers that are still waiting for a warmer day. Each new day pops every day on top of the stack that is cooler, filling in how long each of them waited, and then is pushed itself. Days left on the stack at the end keep a wait of 0.
